---
name: Bug report
about: nolan produced a broken, clipped, or unwatchable demo — or the recorder failed
title: "[bug] "
labels: bug
---

**Which stage?** Storyboard / Record / Polish (or a slash command / the storyboarder agent)

**What you asked nolan to do**
The prompt or `/nolan:*` command you ran, and what you were filming (app, feature).

**What happened**
What went wrong. If it was a *bad video*, note which discipline broke: action clipped
mid-stream (§4), caption sounded like a test (§1), niche/confusing on-screen input (§2),
missing title card / captions (§3), mis-click / bad selector, or wrong pacing.

**What you expected**

**Storyboard (redacted)**
The relevant scene(s) from your `storyboard.json`. Remove any private URLs or data.

**Environment**
- OS + Python version:
- Playwright / Chromium installed? (`playwright install chromium`)
- Claude client (Claude Code / desktop / other) and version:
- Installed as: plugin / cloned skill / project skill

> ⚠️ Do not paste real secrets, private URLs, or customer data. Redact before submitting.
